translation.title: Flurbiprofen Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for pain relief and anti-inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (tennis elbow, etc.), muscle pain, and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
translation.usage: Remove the release liner from the adhesive side and apply the plaster to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are or have been hypersensitive to it or to other flurbiprofen products, or if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, etc.). Do not use it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or rash. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you have inflammation accompanying an infection or a chronic condition (such as degenerative arthritis), or if you are pregnant, a child, or elderly. Wipe off sweat from the application site before use. Adverse reactions may occur - sometimes redness, rash, drug eruption, itching and burning sensation, contact dermatitis, or early symptoms of an asthma attack such as dry crackles, wheezing and difficulty breathing; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from light, and keep out of reach of children.
